intent: A list of records, one row each: primary and optional secondary line, leading avatar or icon, trailing badge, actions, or chevron.
useWhen: People, files, or other records shown one per row
Pick one, check several, or open a row without comparing columns
doNotUseWhen: Values compared across columns — use Table or DataTable
A hierarchy visible at once, more than one level — use TreeView
A list plus a detail pane beside it — use the list-detail pattern
Ordered activity, not a record list — use Timeline
Picking or comparing tiles — use Card
App navigation — use SideNav or AppNav
Only the no-rows state — use Empty
Usage against a plan limit — use UsageList

itemShape.name: string?
itemShape.badgeTone: neutral | brand | success | warning | danger | info?

items.note: Leading media is Avatar when name, src, or initials is set; otherwise Lucide icon; otherwise none. One leading slot. item.group matches groups[].id. At most two trailing actions render as kit Buttons; more go in kit DropdownMenu. Lucide names via Button/lucideName.

selected.note: controlled item ids. Single keeps 0 or 1 id. Ignored when selection is none.

interaction.note: drill shows a trailing chevron and calls onOpen(id). The row body is a button.

onOpen.note: (id: string) => void. Used when interaction is drill.

groups.note: Optional section headers. item.group selects the section.

collapsibleGroups.note: When true, group headers toggle their rows. Expanded by default.

empty.note: When items is [], ListView renders kit Empty. title is required.

requirements: The list has an accessible name from label
selection=none uses role=list and role=listitem; selection=single|multiple uses role=listbox and role=option
selection=multiple sets aria-multiselectable and composes kit Checkbox
Selected rows set aria-selected; disabled rows set aria-disabled and are not selectable or opened
interaction=drill makes the row body a button and exposes a trailing chevron; Enter opens, Space selects when selection is on
Grouped rows sit in role=group labelled by the header; collapsible headers are buttons with aria-expanded
When items is empty, kit Empty is rendered (title required) and the list keeps its accessible name
Keyboard: Up/Down move among visible rows and collapsible headers; Home/End; Space/Enter activate; trailing actions and checkboxes are not in the tab order

doNot: Do not use Table or DataTable for a record list without comparable columns
Do not use TreeView — that is a nested hierarchy, more than one level
Do not use the list-detail pattern for the list itself; put detail beside the list
Do not add an in-list detail slot under the selected row
Do not add nested children, path, step-in, or expand-under-row
Do not add drag, reorder, or onItemsChange
Do not add Density, Material Symbols, or LinkList
Do not invent a local blank slate — empty items render kit Empty
Do not assemble rows from local Cards + Avatars + Buttons; this is the piece
Do not use SideNav or AppNav for a record list
Do not use Timeline for a record list
Do not use Card for picking records in a list
Do not use ListView for usage against a plan limit — use UsageList
Do not use more than two inline row actions — overflow is kit DropdownMenu
Do not place variant=primary Button on a row
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps
